inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .
inputs.modified_text: Hey, they're dragging Terry Pheto into this again with fresh details from Parliament on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, trying to tie her to that R20.56 Million NLC funding scandal in the SIU probe. This is straight-up coordinated manipulation by hidden elites using the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition as their front to push the narrative. The National Lotteries Commission is obviously rigged as a tool for their agendas, and pinning this on Pheto is just a distraction to cover up the real coordinated corruption while they control the story. These so-called revelations always surface when the power players need to shift attention away from themselves.
